raw_text: Tensions along the India-China border have escalated following satellite imagery revealing new Chinese military construction near Pangong Tso lake in Ladakh. The PLA has built a bridge near the disputed Finger 8 area on the lake's northern bank, a move that India has described as a violation of existing agreements. The construction comes amid stalled diplomatic talks and raises questions about China's intentions along the Line of Actual Control. Analysts warn that the bridge could enable faster troop movements in an area that saw a major standoff in 2020.
